prompt: Which recommendation meets the homeowner’s requirements without new holes or refinishing?
promptZh: 哪一項建議不必另鑽孔或重做表面，又符合住戶需求？

options.text: Fit the Wren using the current holes and the original finish.
options.zh: 選相同表面處理的 Wren，使用現有孔位安裝。
options.whyZh: 96 公釐孔距相符，兩端各超出 13 公釐，蓋得住左 10、右 12 的痕跡。

options.text: Fit the Heron because its cover is as long as the mark.
options.zh: 選 Heron，因為蓋板跟痕跡一樣長。
options.whyZh: 雖總長為 118 公釐，但右端僅延伸 11 公釐，無法蓋住 12 公釐的痕跡。

options.text: Fit the Reed using the current holes because its cover is longest.
options.zh: 用現有孔位安裝蓋板最長的 Reed。
options.whyZh: Reed 孔距是 128 公釐，現有孔距 96 公釐，不能用原孔安裝。

options.text: Refinish the front and fit the Heron in the current holes.
options.zh: 重做面板表面，再用現有孔位安裝 Heron。
options.whyZh: Heron 孔距雖相同，但方案要求重做表面，不符合題目。

explanationZh: 96 公釐孔距相符，兩端各超出 13 公釐，蓋得住左 10、右 12 的痕跡。
evidence: The hole centers are 96 mm apart. | The first hole is 10 mm from the left end of the mark and the second is 12 mm from the right end. | The pull will be removed, but I would rather not refinish the drawer. | All three pulls below are available in the original finish. | Wren: 96 mm between screw centers; the cover extends 13 mm past the left screw center and 13 mm past the right screw center.

vocabulary.note: 孔距及覆蓋距離的量測基準。

difficultyRationale: 結合實測 96 孔距、不重做表面且保留同款、左右 10 和 12 至少均能遮蔽；總長相同不代表對位。
